reuse_not_duplicate: OdeProblem::linearize_matrix_free (frozen JVP operator at t_m, y_m)
rodas5p_krylov::solve_gmres and solve_block_gmres (existing true-residual exits, rank deflation)
ppsw1 private validators via child-module visibility
module_placement: ppsw1_linear_backend.rs is declared inside ppsw1.rs with #[path] as ppsw1::linear_backend, so crates/rodas5p-integrators/src/lib.rs is not edited

changes.behavior: LinearBackend::{Dense, MatrixFree(MatrixFreeConfig)}; Dense calls the unchanged ppsw1::solve_stages. MatrixFree: refuse before callbacks if mass matrix or no JVP; per stage rhs_i = explicit_i + h J transfer_i (one charged JVP), solve W x_i = rhs_i by independent GMRES (stage-parallel, all jobs joined, first error in stage order) or one block GMRES over six RHS; then backend true residual ||rhs_i - W x_i|| <= slack * max(atol, rtol ||rhs_i||) with one charged W application per stage (optional, default on). Identity preconditioner only.
advance_with_backend and Session::with_linear_backend (builder; default Dense). Existing advance/Session/try_step behavior and counters unchanged for Dense. Session keeps the last LinearReport.

start_with_policy(StarterPolicy{allow_dense_matrix, allow_newton}): the only starter needs a dense 5n LU and simplified Newton; any prohibition returns InvalidInput before any callback. No matrix-free starter is claimed.

changes.evidence: Fisher N=40, block GMRES with linear rtol >= step rtol: tol 1e-8 took 1.13e6 accepted steps and moved the endpoint 58 tol units; tol 1e-5 with linear rtol 1e-4 took 10.7x steps (0.20 tol units). Linear rtol <= 1e-2 * step rtol kept the endpoint within 1.1e-3 tol units of Dense in every row.
changes.behavior: Session::try_step refuses with InvalidInput, before any callback, when the matrix-free linear rtol exceeds LINEAR_BUDGET_RATIO (1e-2) times the step rtol, or (step rtol == 0) the linear atol exceeds LINEAR_BUDGET_RATIO times the step atol. attempt/advance carry no step tolerance and are not guarded (documented).
changes.observation_not_changed: production solve_gmres tests its threshold only between restart cycles (no in-cycle exit), so restart >= n solves to Krylov exhaustion regardless of rtol; documented and measured with restart 10 arms, Krylov source unchanged

acceptance: dense parity (diagonal, stiff nonnormal, rank-deficient six-RHS) with true residuals
stagnation/breakdown typed failures, NaN JVP, state preservation and charged work
permission refusals before callbacks (no JVP, mass, strict starter)
full-IVP: endpoint deviation vs Dense as a function of linear tolerance (residual-to-step-error budget)
measured crossover: paired interleaved wall time (2 warmups, 7 repetitions) Dense vs MF on Fisher MOL N scan; counters for JVP, reductions, startup, rejected work
preconditioner: identity only; preconditioner-failure contract NOT_APPLICABLE until a preconditioner is admitted
non_goals: no derivative-free or whole-run matrix-free/Newton-free claim
